description: Road Safety Camera Network - Trends in Fines Hume Freeway is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. Trends in fines for each of the seven highway camera systems within the State of Victoria since each highway camera system began operating. Fines are recorded at the offence date. Victoria Police suspended the use of all point-to-point cameras on the Hume Freeway on 14 October 2010. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are Fines, Hume Highway, Recorded Fines, Road Safety Camera Network, Speed Cameras. It offers 3 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
